meta.route: ROUTE B (via a direct machine-readable PDF, not AnyFlip) — OAE Zone 6 (Eastern) 'ข้อมูลเอกภาพ' district-comparison PDFs, hosted natively on zone6.oae.go.th/wp-content/uploads (not a flipbook; no OCR was needed, text extracted directly with pdfplumber).
meta.coverage: 9 Eastern-region provinces only (Nakhon Nayok, Prachinburi, Sa Kaeo, Chachoengsao, Chonburi, Rayong, Chanthaburi, Trat, Samut Prakan) = OAE Zone 6's jurisdiction. NOT the requested Isan zone 5/6 books (zone 5's site had no equivalent public data page found this session; zone6.oae.go.th is Eastern region, not Isan) and NOT nationwide.
meta.year: 16 crop-specific PDFs; annual/row crops compare 2565/66 vs 2566/67 (BE) = 2022/23 vs 2023/24 CE, newest column used; perennial tree crops (durian, rubber, coffee, pepper, coconut, mangosteen, longkong, longan) compare calendar years 2566 vs 2567 (BE) = 2023 vs 2024 CE, newest column used; oil palm/rubber/coconut/pineapple files are labelled 65-66 (2022/23-2023 vintage) - one year older than the rice/durian/etc files.
meta.label: OAE Zone 6 (สศท.6) เอกภาพ ระดับอำเภอ crop comparison PDFs, per-crop, 2 most recent years each
parse_notes: Extracted via pdfplumber page.extract_tables() (native PDF text/table structure, not OCR) - each PDF has one repeating table spanning multiple pages (ภาค > จังหวัด > อำเภอ hierarchy, no explicit indentation column so province/amphoe rows are told apart by matching row-1 text against a hardcoded list of the 9 known zone-6 province names; anything not on that list and not containing 'ภาค' is treated as an amphoe row belonging to the most-recently-seen province).

KNOWN DATA-QUALITY CAVEAT: a subset of Thai strings extracted from these PDFs have a font/glyph-reordering artifact affecting words containing the เ-ือ / ำ vowel clusters, e.g. 'เมือง' (Mueang) extracts as 'เมอื ง' (extra space, transposed สระอือ), 'บ้าน' (Ban) extracts as 'บา้ น', 'น้ำ' extracts as 'น ้า'. This affects roughly a third of amphoe names (province names in the hardcoded list were checked and are NOT affected). amphoe_th values are stored RAW (uncorrected) - do not treat as canonical spelling; a human or fuzzy-match pass against th_amphoe.geojson amphoe names is needed before joining this data to the amphoe pipeline.

Each source PDF also contains one extra table (last 1-2 pages) with a different schema - a month-by-month harvest-timing distribution table (percent of production by month, province-level only, not amphoe-level). That table has a different column count and was automatically excluded (see skipped_tables per file in this meta if > 0).

planted_rai / harvested_rai use the crop-appropriate area concept: for annual/row crops (rice, corn, cassava, pineapple) these are เนื้อที่เพาะปลูก (planted) and เนื้อที่เก็บเกี่ยว (harvested); for perennial tree crops (durian, rubber, coffee, pepper, coconut, mangosteen, longkong, longan, oil palm) these are เนื้อที่ยืนต้น (standing/mature tree area, mapped to planted_rai) and เนื้อที่ให้ผล/เนื้อที่กรีดได้ (fruiting/tappable area, mapped to harvested_rai).

yield_kg_per_rai uses the 'per harvested/tappable/fruiting area' column where the source offers two yield columns (per-planted vs per-harvested); where only one yield column exists (perennial crops) that single column is used.

Only the NEWEST of the two compared years is carried into planted_rai/harvested_rai/production_tons/yield_kg_per_rai; both years' raw table values remain recoverable from the archived PDFs in source-data/raw/doae-amphoe/zone6/ if the prior year is needed later.

Route A (production.doae.go.th, the interactive query system that could in principle serve true amphoe-level, any-crop, any-province data) is LOGIN-GATED (redirects to /site/login, Yii-based auth) - not accessed, no credentials attempted.

Route A's static PDF archive mirror (www.agriinfo.doae.go.th, an old Bitrix site with open Apache directory listings for years 2559-2563 / 2016-2020) was explored as a fallback: it only publishes PROVINCE-level crop rankings and province-level per-crop tables, never amphoe-level, and the public directory listing stops being available after year63 (BE2563/CE2020) - years 64-68 (2021-2026) all 404/redirect to the same production.doae.go.th login. Sample PDFs for the 3 requested provinces (Nakhon Ratchasima, Chiang Mai, Nakhon Si Thammarat) were pulled and confirmed province-level only; not included in the rows below.

Zone 5 (สศท.5, Nakhon Ratchasima - covers Lower Isan: Nakhon Ratchasima, Chaiyaphum, Buriram, Surin) was searched for an equivalent 'ข้อมูลเอกภาพ' public data page; only found a January-2026 committee-meeting news post about standardizing zone-wide crop data ('เอกภาพระดับภาคด้านพืช ภาคตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือ ครั้งที่ 1/2569') with no attached downloadable PDFs. Zone5's own site does not appear to publish the finished per-amphoe PDFs the way zone6 does (or they are not indexed/linked from the pages this session could reach). AnyFlip flipbooks specifically (the originally-suspected Route B mechanism) were NOT found on either zone5 or zone6 - both zones that were checked publish plain PDFs directly instead, which turned out to be strictly better (no OCR needed).
